lines.zh: 鳞片闪烁，威风凛凛翱翔天际。
lines.en: Scales shimmer as it soars through the sky.

lines.zh: 巨翼拍动，俯冲而来，气场强大。
lines.en: Wings flap, diving in with immense presence.

lines.zh: 长尾摆动，尾巴上的尖刺闪亮。
lines.en: Tail sways, sharp spikes glinting at the end.

lines.zh: 龙吟响彻云霄，震慑四方。
lines.en: Roar echoes in the clouds, striking fear.

lines.zh: 锋利爪子，抓住猎物毫不费力。
lines.en: Sharp claws grab prey with ease.

lines.zh: 我在凝视丘陵上空绕圈。
lines.en: I circle above the Gaze Hills.
Long, sharp horns curve like knives.

lines.zh: 双翼展开，扫过凝视丘陵。
lines.en: Wings spread, I sweep the Gazing Hills.
When I land, the ground sinks beneath me.
Head held high, as if thinking.

lines.zh: 眼睛一动不动地盯着远处。
lines.en: Stares intently at a distant point.
My lids close, but my eyes keep turning.

lines.zh: 我伏在岩脊上，慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: Sprawled on the ridge, I blink slowly.

lines.zh: 翼膜收拢，鼻孔冒着热气。
lines.en: Wings folded, heat plumes from my nostrils.
I wait for prey to make the first mistake.
I scrape the stone to sharpen my claws.

lines.zh: 我飞起来，影子盖住丘陵。
lines.en: I lift off; my shadow covers the hill.
Stares at the player, eyes sharp.
Flies towards the player, ready to attack.
Wings flap, quickly closing the distance.
Eyes glow, locking onto the target.
Circling in the air, looking for an opening.

lines.zh: 俯冲而下，准备抓住玩家。
lines.en: Dives down, ready to grab the player.

lines.zh: 千百只眼睛一起看向你。
lines.en: A thousand eyes look at you at once.

lines.zh: 我低头，你正好在影子里。
lines.en: I look down; you are right in my shadow.

lines.zh: 这么小的猎物，也敢抬头。
lines.en: So small a prey, daring to look up.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔里映出你自己。
lines.en: My pupil reflects you back at yourself.
Do not move. I am measuring your bones.

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤，它飞不起来了。
鳞片破碎，它的伤痕累累。
lines.en: Its scales are cracked, badly injured.
It fell into water, badly injured.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着诱人的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with tempting light.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀掠过天空，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Its wings glide through the sky, seeking prey.
It lowers its head when I approach.

lines.zh: 它用锐利的目光注视着我。
lines.en: Its sharp gaze fixes on me.

lines.zh: 它张开巨大的翅膀，准备飞翔。
lines.en: It spreads its giant wings, ready to fly.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，眼睛还看着你。
lines.en: I spread my wings, eyes still on you.

lines.zh: 它的咆哮在山谷中回响。
lines.en: Its roar echoes in the valley.
It dives down to snatch me.
Its gaze is filled with desire.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀撞上了我的盾牌。
lines.en: Its wings collide with my shield.

lines.zh: 我们撞上了同一块岩石。
lines.en: We crash into the same rock.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴击中了我的手臂。
它的爪子卡在我的盔甲里。
lines.en: Its claws get stuck in my armor.
Its head collides with my sword.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片划破了我的衣服。
它的身体撞开了我的防线。

lines.en: Its tail sweeps past my feet.

lines.zh: 它的爪子抓住了我的盾牌。
它的头撞上了我的头盔。
lines.en: Its head collides with my helmet.
It searches for the sound of a mate.

lines.zh: 它的叫声引来了一只雌眼龙。
lines.en: Its call draws a female Eyekin.

lines.zh: 它用嘴轻吻另一只眼龙。
lines.en: It gently kisses another Eyekin with its mouth.

lines.zh: 它们绕圈飞舞，展示力量。
lines.en: They fly in circles, showing their strength.

lines.zh: 它们的眼眸闪烁着爱意。
翅膀摩擦，寻找藏身之所！
地面不是我的家，天空才是！
lines.en: Earth not my home, sky is.

lines.zh: 雷鸣般的怒吼，威慑敌人！
猎物就在眼前，锁定目标！

lines.en: The shadow falling on the ground is me.

lines.zh: 锁定飞行目标，准备俯冲！
lines.en: Air target locked, ready to dive.

lines.zh: 整片丘陵都是我的猎场。
lines.en: The whole hill range is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 锁定地面目标，准备伏击！
lines.en: Ground target locked, ready to ambush.

lines.zh: 锁定猎物，准备发动攻击！

lines.en: My eyes turn to you. Locked.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气出卖了你。

lines.en: Skimming low, I have found you.
One beat of my wings, and you are chosen.
One circle in the air, and I land on you.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我翼下缩小。
lines.en: Your shadow shrinks under my wings.
The wind is right, and so are you.
Run all you like; you cannot outrun my wings.

lines.zh: 我飞起来时，地面就暗了。
lines.en: When I take flight, the ground goes dark.
Look up. I am right above you.
Snarl and bite at the foe
Claw at the attacker with claws
Plunge down and whip with tail

lines.zh: 挥动翅膀制造气流压制
张开翅膀形成旋风攻击
用尾巴扫击，令敌人昏厥

lines.en: My tail sweeps, and you fly.

lines.zh: 我把你从地上提起来了。
lines.en: I have lifted you off the ground.

lines.zh: 在岩层缝隙中逐渐显现
在凝视丘陵的岩层中孵化
凝视丘陵的岩缝裂开了。
lines.en: A crack opens in the Gazing Hills.
My wing-shadow arrives before I land.

lines.zh: 我从高处滑下，落在岩脊。
lines.en: I glide down and settle on the ridge.

lines.zh: 骨头在多风的丘陵上长齐。
lines.en: Bones finish forming on the windy hills.
The valley's echo wakes before I do.

lines.zh: 我从云层里掉下来，展开翼。
lines.en: I fall out of the clouds and spread my wings.
The wind over this land is mine now.

lines.zh: 很远的地方，有人抬头了。
lines.en: Somewhere far off, someone looks up.
